tools.name: find-an-area
tools.description: Which area a place's name means, among those where EuKreate has homes for sale: a city (with its state), a 5-digit ZIP code, a county or a region such as "the East Bay". status matched: search areas[0]. choose: ask which of areas was meant.

tools.name: find-homes-from-a-request-in-words
tools.description: Homes for a request in the person's own words: the area, budget, beds and baths become hard filters; wishes such as a big yard, a view, a good lot, an easy commute or a drive under 30 minutes to a named city rank the homes by fit.

tools.name: get-one-home-s-details
tools.description: Everything EuKreate can share about one active home for sale: price and facts, HOA and taxes when on record, assigned public schools, access to amenities and commutes, flood zone and hazard ratings for its Census tract (not the home itself), crime rates for its police agency with the state and…

tools.name: search-homes-for-sale
tools.description: Active for-sale homes in one area that meet every filter given. Returns up to 25 homes a page, the total, the filters as applied and search_url, the same search on EuKreate.
